newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar drifts lower in corrective move.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar drifts lower in corrective move.

text.p: White sugar futures edged lower this morning which was seen as part of a downward correction to recent gains.
But dealers reckoned that the market was still underpinned by a potential tightening of European white sugar supplies during the summer months.
They said that near term, traders would be watching the New York market where the funds had built up a significant long position. But any sell-off would likely find buying from the trade.
This morning's volume of 597 lots at 1100 GMT was boosted by Oct/Mch and Dec/Mch switching activity.
Prices were $0.90 to $0.40 a tonne down with last business in August at $327.50 a tonne.
Paris white sugar was down $1.10 in the August position where turnover was 161 lots.
